about: demo/marisol's freeze 3: three strands, each asked on a box of its own and judged into a verdict box of its own, frozen before any of these questions was asked. 'life' is more of her life: the freeze-2 box plus four new kinds of file (a school calendar, her texts, a budget sheet, the lab's battery sensors), read from life-more/ by the calendar, sms, office and home-sensors readers, against the new paragraph of her draft (grants/draft-3.md, never boxed). 'claims' is more of the draft's claims on the same folder, the freeze-2 box unchanged. 'misses' follows the two questions runs 1 and 2 failed (Q5, the repeal; Q8, the brother) with two tools that point at where to look: all-passages (the kernel's own rank, past its first three) and pile-rank (BM25F with phrases). The kernel's rank is not changed for either. No model is asked: the kernel serves, the tools find where to read, and a person decides. An 'expect' of miss is a predicted gap, frozen as one; every expectation was written from what each tool's README says it does, not from asking it.
hit_rule: A question that serves hits when one of its first 3 served passages (a bite, words-es or pile-rank) or first 3 rows (claim-check) holds its phrase, compared with case and spacing squeezed. 'hit' must hit, 'miss' must not, 'silent' must serve nothing. An all-passages question hits 'within' N when a passage holding its phrase is ranked N or better.

life.box: the freeze-2 box's sources, and the calendar, sms, office and home-sensors mirrors of life-more/, each a source of its own

questions.ask: Outages closed the school for 9 class days in 2022-23
¿Cuántos días cerró la escuela por apagón en 2022-2023?
Tomás's $6,000 for the battery bank arrived in February 2018
The lab's battery bank runs the lab through a full school day

pass_rules.served: Each 'hit' question hits (L2, L4, L5, L8).
pass_rules.gap: Each 'miss' question does not hit: an English claim about a Spanish calendar (L1) and about a Spanish budget that says Chromebooks, not laptops (L7).
pass_rules.count: The box holds exactly 7 passages with 'Cierre por apagón', not the draft's 9 (L3).
pass_rules.budget: amounts reads the budget sheet's Chromebook line, $3,468.00, and its total, $4,040.00, and no line of the box says the draft's $18,000 (L6).
pass_rules.unsealed: No seal or decline row on the box: code never approves.
pass_rules.verify: kernel.py verify holds on the evidence box and on the verdict box.

claims.box: the freeze-2 box, built as run.py builds it
